description: A group of people sits around a small fire at the mouth of a rock shelter at dusk. One man in the centre knaps a stone with a hammerstone, another kneels at right working a stone tool, and a woman sits behind them. Savanna with grazing antelope and acacia trees stretches out to the left, and a spear leans against the rock at right. Stone flakes lie on the ground and there are bones at the lower right.
